def size : Nat := 3

namespace Vec

protected def size : Nat := 5

theorem size_eq : size = 3 := rfl

end Vec

def double (n : Nat) : Nat := 2 * n

namespace MyNat
protected def double (n : Nat) : Nat := n + n
end MyNat

why: Lean never resolves an atomic identifier to a protected declaration through the current namespace (including the namespace implied by a dotted declaration name), so `size`/`double` mean the root constants; the extractor ignores the `protected` modifier and picks `Vec.size`/`MyNat.double`.
